# Global Advantage Partnership

> Industrial Excellence. Delivered.

Global Advantage Partnership provides specialist industrial advisory with Turnaround Excellence as the flagship service. The foundation of Turnaround Management is a Risk-First Approach and the golden rules are “Anticipate. Anticipate. Anticipate.” The signature statement is “A turnaround is an exercise into risk management.”

## Core capabilities
- [Turnaround Excellence](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/turnaround-excellence/)
- [Risk-First Approach](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/turnaround-excellence/risk-first-approach.html)
- [Turnaround Preparation & Readiness](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/turnaround-excellence/preparation-readiness.html)
- [Contractor Performance & Productivity](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/turnaround-excellence/contractor-performance.html)
- [CAPEX & Project Excellence](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/capex-projects/)
- [Independent Project Assurance](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/capex-projects/governance-assurance.html)
- [Other industrial services](https://jpreis-web.github.io/globaladvantage/services/)

## Turnaround success criteria in order
1. Safety
2. Quality
3. Duration
4. Cost
